items.title: Make story_review numeric round field explicit
items.context: The handler response currently uses reviewRound: reviewData.reviews.length for PLAN review rounds, while signed finding/pass artifacts use reviewRound as story.currentReviewRound ISO string. Keep behavior compatible if needed, but add a clearly named numeric field such as planReviewRound/reviewRoundNumber and make the ambiguity visible in tests/docs.

happy.desc: After implementation, `koala story_review ... --json` exposes the PLAN review count through an explicitly numeric field such as `planReviewRound` or `reviewRoundNumber`, and that field equals the number of PLAN review rounds recorded for the story.

edge.desc: For compatibility, any retained legacy `reviewRound` field in the story_review response is documented or aliased as the numeric PLAN review round only, while new code/tests prefer the explicit numeric name.

adversarial.desc: A maintainer comparing story_review output with signed finding/review-pass artifacts cannot reasonably infer that signed artifact `reviewRound` is numeric; the output/schema/docs distinguish PLAN round number from signed artifact ISO reviewRound.

items.userSees: Maintainer sees JSON containing "planReviewRound": 1 and "reviewRound": 1, then docs say "story_review.reviewRound is a legacy numeric PLAN review alias; signed artifact reviewRound remains ISO string".

items.title: Add regression coverage for reviewRound schema distinction
items.context: Tests should prove signed finding/pass reviewRound remains ISO string and story_review numeric round is exposed under an unambiguous name, so future contract drift catches this class of confusion.

happy.desc: Regression coverage proves signed finding artifacts and review-pass artifacts still emit `reviewRound` as an ISO 8601 string sourced from `story.currentReviewRound`.

edge.desc: Regression coverage proves story_review structured output exposes the numeric PLAN review round under an unambiguous field name and does not require consumers to treat signed artifact `reviewRound` as a number.

adversarial.desc: Contract/docs verification fails if future changes collapse the two meanings again: story_review PLAN round number and signed artifact ISO `reviewRound` must be described and guarded as distinct process facts.

items.userSees: Maintainer sees "story review structured output verified" and "Process fact contract verified"; failures mention PLAN review round vs signed ISO reviewRound if the distinction regresses.
